items.t: AST SpaceMobile Is Down 37% in a Month. Can B. Riley’s Upgrade Get ASTS Stock Back to $48?
items.sum: A rocket engine deal, a flood of new shares and three satellites stuck on the ground have battered AST SpaceMobile. One Wall Street firm says the worst is already priced in, but the launch calendar will decide who is right.

items.t: Why AST SpaceMobile Stock Just Popped
items.sum: B. Riley thinks AST SpaceMobile is a buy at half-off.

items.t: AST SpaceMobile Rises 5% as B. Riley Upgrades, Says Launch and Funding Risks Are “Already Priced In”
items.sum: Key TakeawaysAST SpaceMobile rose 5% today as B. Riley upgraded it to Buy with a $48 target.

items.t: ASTS Stock Gets A Breather After Relentless Sell-Off: B. Riley Says Launch Delays, Funding Risks Are Already Priced In
items.sum: B. Riley said investors are overlooking the potential benefits of AST SpaceMobile developing its own launch capabilities.

items.t: AST SpaceMobile Stock Has Fallen Far Enough, Analyst Says. He Sees Nearly 90% Upside.
items.sum: B. Riley upgraded the satellite company to Buy, saying the selloff had priced in many of the risks tied to launch delays and rocket development.

items.t: Redwire Climbs 4% on $15 Million AscendArc Solar Deal and Oppenheimer Initiation; AST SpaceMobile Jumps 8%, Rocket Lab Gains 3%
items.sum: Redwire is stacking up contract wins and a record backlog, yet its revenue keeps missing the mark. Why a supplier to the space boom lags louder peers, and what could finally close the gap, may decide whether this bounce lasts.
